identity_note: Matched Iterative Health (formerly Iterative Scopes), Cambridge, MA clinical-research site network at iterative.health. Sector (clinical research), website and Series-stage funding match the batch entry; no name collision found.

profile.name: Iterative Health
profile.description: Builds and runs a network of community-based clinical research sites (GI, hepatology, obesity, cardiology) and sells trial execution and patient access to pharma and biotech sponsors; 100+ sites across North America, Europe, India and Australia.
profile.location: Cambridge, MA (675 Massachusetts Ave) and New York, NY; operations office in Southlake, TX; sites in US, Europe, India, Australia
profile.funding_detail: Series C $77M closed Apr 30, 2026, led by Intrepid Growth Partners and GV, with new investors EDBI and a family office and existing investors Insight Partners and Obvious Ventures. Total raised to date not stated in the release.
profile.headcount: 250+ worldwide per the company's own Oct 2026 job posting; ~167 per Revelio Labs (Mar 2026); LinkedIn-derived figure ~127 via an aggregator
profile.past_completed_deals: Three Texas cardiology research sites (Beaumont, Port Arthur, Waco) from NextStage Clinical Research (May 2026); Clinical Research Strategy Group and Precision Research (IBD trial firms, Grapevine TX area; Apr 2022, as Iterative Scopes). Also non-acquisition site partnerships: US Heart & Vascular (Apr 2026), Gastroenterology Associates of New Jersey (Jul 2026), GI Alliance, One GI.
profile.open_role: VP, Mergers & Acquisitions open as of 2026-10-08 (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/iterativehealth/jobs/4717552006); also Corporate Development Manager open as of 2026-10-08 (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/iterativehealth/jobs/4707385006)

verdict.headline: Active site acquirer · VP M&A and Corp Dev Manager both open
verdict.detail: Fresh $77M Series C funding a site roll-up; corp dev is led by VP Corporate Development Matt Morris, and the new VP M&A will partner with the Chief Development Officer.
